name: Decoy
body:
School illusion (figment); Level bard 1, magus 1, psychic 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect visual figment of you
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw Will disbelief (if interacted with); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You create a visual illusion of yourself as per the spell silent image. This decoy does not move from its space, but it can move in natural ways otherwise. Creatures might be prone to attacking the decoy rather than you if you are hidden.
